description: Source code for the ue_location_manager class, handling UE location reporting configuration, status checks, and report generation within a 3GPP-based system.

classes.name: ue_location_manager
classes.description: Manages UE location reporting configuration, status, and report generation.

methods.name: configure_location_reporting
methods.description: Configures location reporting based on incoming request parameters.

methods.name: get_current_location_reporting_type
methods.description: Returns the current location reporting event type based on configuration.

methods.name: check_ue_presence
methods.description: Checks if a UE is within a specified area of interest.

methods.name: get_location_report
methods.description: Generates a location report for a UE if reporting conditions are met.

methods.name: get_direct_location_report
methods.description: Creates a direct location report based on current location info and request.

methods.name: build_ue_presence_list
methods.description: Builds a list of UE presence items within configured areas of interest.
